proposal.hypothesis: Rebasing each contiguous x row at row_base + x0 and expressing the stencil with unit-stride line pointers may make the unfused scalar loop easier for the frozen compiler's automatic vectorizer to optimize, without an OpenMP SIMD directive or alignment assumption. Previous explicit OpenMP SIMD candidates were valid, but their measurements do not predict this compiler-only formulation.

retained: Retain the unfused single-timestep kernel and existing timestep selection and spatial bounds.
Form each row pointer at the flattened row base plus x0, then traverse the interior with a zero-based contiguous x loop.
Replace flattened per-cell index macros with line-pointer accesses while preserving stencil neighbor order and arithmetic order.
Add no explicit SIMD directive, alignment assumption, threading, blocking, or compiler-flag change.
